prd_summary: Cross-functional operational pipeline executing sequential and interleaved tasks across Photoshop, Vscode. Requires strict state continuity, rigorous verification of intermediate deliverables, and accurate tracking of task interruptions and resumptions.

domain_constraints: All intermediate work-in-progress must be saved before switching application contexts.
When an interruption occurs, the primary task state must be preserved and cleanly resumed.
Final outputs must be validated against ticket acceptance criteria.
